# Elevation

> Elevation is a free gym log for one lifter. It records every set, charts progress per machine, and gives one weekly verdict (PROGRESS, HOLD or DIP). Your data is saved to a Google Sheet you own.

## What is Elevation?

Elevation is a personal gym tracker for a single lifter who trains on an Upper and Lower split and uses a phone between sets. It is a static web app hosted on GitHub Pages. It has no framework, no account and no sign-in inside the app.

Each set is saved to your own Google Sheet through an Apps Script web app you deploy yourself. Setup steps are in the project README. Without a Sheet, the app runs in demo mode, and data stays in the browser on that device.

Elevation is designed for a phone at the gym (390px wide, used one-handed) and works on a desktop browser (1024px and up) for reviewing charts and the week.

## What does Elevation offer?

- Log a set fast: reps and weight start from your last set on that machine.
- Weight in kg or lbs, with a live conversion between the two.
- Intensity tag per set: Easy, Med or Hard.
- Charts per machine: estimated 1-rep max (Epley formula) and your top set, session by session, with a history list.
- Favorites grouped as Upper, Lower and Arms & Shoulders.
- Calendar of logged days and planned days, read from the Schedule tab of your Sheet.
- Weekly KPI: one Progress Score and verdict per week, with the three components and a per-exercise breakdown.
- Share a day or a week as a 1080 x 1350 PNG summary image.
- Reminders by email and Google Calendar, configured in Apps Script.
- Demo mode with no Sheet needed.

## Why use Elevation?

- Free, and the data lives in your own Google Sheet, not in an app account.
- The math is public. e1RM = kg x (1 + reps / 30). Score = 0.4 x volume change + 0.4 x average e1RM change + 0.2 x (consistency % - 100). Bands: above +2% is PROGRESS, within plus or minus 2% is HOLD, below -2% is DIP. The first logged week is BASELINE.
- The week verdict and its reason fit on one screen, with no spreadsheet maths.
